newsitem.title: USA: Barney's Inc sales, EBIDTA rise for Jan and Feb.
newsitem.headline: Barney's Inc sales, EBIDTA rise for Jan and Feb.

text.p: Barney's Inc said Wednesday that sales for the nine-week period ending March 1 were $57.1 million, compared with sales of $50.7 million for the year-ago period.
The company said earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization for the period were $2.6 million.
Barney's, the parent firm of Barney's New York, is in Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
The company said comparable store sales for its full price and outlet stores in January and February were up 22.1 percent year-on-year.
Comparable store sales during the nine-week period beginning January 5 and ending March 1 were $41.9 million, compared to $34.3 million for the 1996 period, the company said.
